name: Brittle bladder fern
desc: Brittle bladder fern (Cystopteris fragilis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cystopteris fragilis is a species of perennial fern known by the common names brittle bladder-fern and common fragile fern. It can be found worldwide, generally in shady, moist areas.
